description: This file defines the AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider class, responsible for providing AWS credentials by assuming a role with a web identity. It includes methods for loading configuration, reading a token file, and interacting with AWS STS service to get temporary credentials, with asynchronous handling via Promises.

classes.name: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentityCredentialProvider
classes.description: Credential provider that obtains AWS credentials by assuming a role with a web identity token, supporting asynchronous operation and retries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider, loading configuration from parameters and environment variables, setting up the STS client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Loads credentials via assuming a role with web identity token asynchronously, handling token reading and retries.
